output.reason: Evidence states that for all floating rate loans granted for business purpose to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises (MSE), where the UCB is Tier 3, no pre-payment charges shall be levied if the sanctioned amount/limit is up to ₹50 lakh (UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025, para 261(2)(ii)). The case specifies a Tier 3 UCB, floating rate, business purpose, borrower as MSE, sanctioned date 15 March 2026 (on/after 1 Jan 2026), and sanctioned amount ₹40 lakh (i.e., ≤ ₹50 lakh). Therefore, pre-payment charges are not permitted for this loan.
